daily.title: Stop ITR Filing & Delete PAN? What You Need to Know
daily.summary: Discover if surrendering your PAN stops ITR filing. Learn the truth about PAN cancellation, filing obligations, and what happens if you stop filing. PAN cancellation is a narrow, documentation-driven process meant for specific situations like duplicate PANs, deceased taxpayers, or foreign nationals permanently exiting India. It was never designed as a compliance workaround. There is no provision in the Income Tax Act for "deleting" a PAN the way one might delete an app or an account.

daily.title: Cash Transaction Limit: RBI New Money Transfer Rules 2026
daily.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has issued the Domestic Money Transfer (DMT) Directions, 2026 with immediate effect. The Directions consolidate various existing instr While the Directions have been presented as RBI's new Domestic Money Transfer framework, many of the transaction limits remain unchanged. The primary objective of the Directions is to consolidate existing instructions, strengthen customer protection measures and enhance operational safeguards. The Domestic Money Transfer (DMT) framework was originally introduced to facilitate small-value fund transfers through formal banking channels, particularly for migrant workers and individuals who may not have easy access to regular banking facilities.
